description: This file contains implementation of ASCII string manipulation functions, including case conversion and whitespace removal, within the Abseil C++ library.

methods.name: AsciiStrToLower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase ASCII characters.

methods.name: AsciiStrToUpper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase ASCII characters.

methods.name: RemoveExtraAsciiWhitespace
methods.description: Removes extra whitespace characters from a string, collapsing consecutive whitespace into a single space.
